Subject: Ulvara Fabrication - Referral Questions

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Ulvara Fabrication. I have everything I need to move forward, and the risk fits our appetite well.

Before I can finalize a quote, I need to refer a few items to my manager:

- Can you confirm the primary operations at each location? (e.g., welding, cutting, assembly)
- What are the fire protection features at both sites? (sprinklers, alarms, distance to fire department)
- Any hot work or hazardous materials storage?

Once I have these details, I should be able to turn around a competitive quote quickly for the 1/3/27 effective date.

Thanks for thinking of us!

[Underwriter name]
